purpose: Introductory RA RNA-seq data literacy; no expression-response statistical analysis
study: BiOCURA; rheumatoid arthritis; RNA drawn before ADA or ETN initiation; response assessed at month 6
limitations: Baseline RNA and six-month clinical response are different measurements and timepoints.
One cell compartment is used; multiple compartments from one patient are not independent patients.
Use author-normalized values as labeled; they are not raw FASTQ or a new normalization performed here.
Presence of a gene row does not establish a drug effect or sufficient expression for a future filtered analysis.
Full source files and participant-level clinical metadata are not republished.
